summary.text: Rosalind Osgood represents District 32 in the Florida Senate, elected on March 8, 2022.

paragraphs.text: Osgood served on the Broward County School Board from 2012 to 2022.

Osgood is a chief executive officer, was born in Fort Lauderdale, and holds degrees from Nova Southeastern University (bachelor's 1996, master's 1997, DPA 2002) and a Master of Divinity from New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary (2010).
